evidence.excerpt: We introduce ServerBench, a benchmark for agentic design of complete, specialized LLM serving systems.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Overall, ServerBench supports systematic study of how agents translate service objectives and feedback into effective, verified serving systems for given task specifications.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across 11 coding-agent models and three deployments, Claude Sonnet 5.5 achieves 2.97 dollars per dollar on Gemma E4B, $4.87\times$ the vLLM reference; 22 of 33 runs yield verified systems, and 13 exceed the strongest baseline.
